name: A Day's Travel
effect: You and your _Spirit_ gain _Fatigue_ at the end of the day. If you do not use any Spiritcraft and do not manifest your Spirit, they do not gain _Fatigue_. You may remove a _Fatigue_ you would take by spending [-].
special: If you have a _Heavy Load_, take an additional _Fatigue_.

name: Time Passes
effect: Time passes; if any characters have not taken a _Travel Action_ this phase, they may take it now. If they did not _Detour_ during this _Phase_, mark one Progress. Characters may then either _Make Camp_ or continue traveling.

name: Comfortable Camp
effect: You find a fortuitous camp site; if you wish, you may decide to _Make Camp_. If you do, characters may spend any amount of [+] or [-] as a _Travel Action_ to remove a single negative modifier from the camp or add Hidden, Defensible, or Comfortable. Regardless of if you stop, _Time Passes_.

name: Lost
effect: At the start of the day make a _Navigation Roll_ against the DC placed on this card. If you meet or exceed the DC, make _Progress_ as normal. If you fail, lose one _Progress_. Some effects allow you to reroll the _Navigation Roll_.
